description: This file defines the StatCounter class used for statistical calculations such as mean, variance, standard deviation, and merging statistics. It is ported from Spark's Scala implementation and is part of the PySpark library, specifically related to statistical counters within Spark.

classes.name: StatCounter
classes.description: A class for computing and merging statistical summaries such as count, mean, variance, min, max, and standard deviation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a StatCounter object, optionally with an iterable of float values.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Adds a new value to the statistics, updating internal counters.

methods.name: mergeStats
methods.description: Merges another StatCounter's statistics into this one.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the StatCounter object.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of values counted.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the values.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Returns the sum of all values.

methods.name: variance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the values.

methods.name: sampleVariance
methods.description: Returns the sample variance, correcting for bias.

methods.name: stdev
methods.description: Returns the standard deviation of the values.

methods.name: sampleStdev
methods.description: Returns the sample standard deviation, correcting for bias.

methods.name: asDict
methods.description: Returns the statistics as a dictionary.
